chunks.ar: كان علاء الدين رئيس الشرطة في مدينة قوص،
chunks.en_old: Ala al-Din, chief of police in Kus,
chunks.en_new: Ala al-Din, chief of police in Kus,

chunks.ar: يجلس في بيته ذات مساء حين جاءه رجل حسن الثياب والهيئة.
chunks.en_old: was at home one evening when a well-dressed stranger arrived
chunks.en_new: was sitting at home one evening when a well-dressed, distinguished-looking man came to him.

chunks.ar: وقف خلفه خادم يحمل صندوقًا ثقيلًا،
chunks.en_old: with a servant carrying a heavy chest
chunks.en_new: Behind him stood a servant carrying a heavy chest,

chunks.ar: وطلب الزائر مقابلة الرئيس في أمر سري.
chunks.en_old: and requested a private meeting.
chunks.en_new: and the visitor asked to meet the chief on a secret matter.

chunks.ar: رحب رئيس الشرطة بالرجل، وأجلسه إلى جانبه، وسأله عن حاجته.
chunks.en_old: The chief welcomed him.
chunks.en_new: The police chief welcomed the man, seated him at his side and asked what he needed.
chunks.note: omitted seating him and asking his need

chunks.ar: قال الضيف إنه كان يقطع الطريق ويسرق أموال الناس،
chunks.en_old: The stranger confessed that he had robbed travelers
chunks.en_new: The guest said he used to rob on the highways and steal people's money,

chunks.ar: لكنه يريد أن يترك تلك الحياة ويتوب، ويبدأ عملًا شريفًا.
chunks.en_old: but claimed he now wished to repent and earn an honest living.
chunks.en_new: but he wanted to leave that life, repent and start an honest living.

chunks.ar: أشار الرجل إلى الصندوق،
chunks.en_old: Pointing to the chest,
chunks.en_new: Pointing to the chest,

chunks.ar: وقال إن فيه حليًا وجواهر ومعادن ثمينة تساوي أربعين ألف دينار.
chunks.en_old: he claimed it held jewels and precious metal worth forty thousand dinars.
chunks.en_new: and said it held ornaments, jewels and precious metals worth forty thousand dinars.

chunks.ar: فتح الغطاء، فظهرت أشياء لامعة،
chunks.en_old: He opened it to reveal gleaming ornaments,
chunks.en_new: He opened the lid, and gleaming things appeared,

chunks.ar: وخواتم كبيرة، وأحجار براقة، فتعجب رئيس الشرطة من كثرتها.
chunks.en_old: rings and sparkling stones.
chunks.en_new: large rings and sparkling stones, and the police chief marveled at how many there were.

chunks.ar: قال الزائر إنه لا يريد الاحتفاظ بهذه الأشياء التي حصل عليها في حياته الماضية.
chunks.en_old: He said he wanted none of the goods from his former life.
chunks.en_new: The visitor said he did not want to keep these things he had gained in his past life.

chunks.ar: وعرض أن يسلم الصندوق كله للرئيس مقابل ألف دينار من مال حلال،
chunks.en_old: He offered the whole chest for a thousand honestly earned dinars
chunks.en_new: He offered to hand the whole chest to the chief for a thousand dinars of lawful money,

chunks.ar: يبدأ بها تجارة جديدة تعينه على الاستقامة.
chunks.en_old: to start a lawful trade.
chunks.en_new: with which to start a new trade that would help him stay honest.

chunks.ar: أعجب رئيس الشرطة بما ظنه توبة صادقة،
chunks.en_old: Pleased by the apparent repentance
chunks.en_new: The police chief was impressed by what he took for sincere repentance,

chunks.ar: وسر أيضًا بما بدا له من ربح كبير.
chunks.en_old: and the apparent bargain,
chunks.en_new: and was also pleased by what looked like a big profit.

chunks.ar: نادى خازنه وأمره بإحضار ألف دينار،
chunks.en_old: the chief ordered his treasurer to bring a thousand dinars.
chunks.en_new: He called his treasurer and ordered him to bring a thousand dinars,

chunks.ar: فدفعها إلى الرجل، وتسلم منه الصندوق في الحال.
chunks.en_old: He paid the stranger and accepted the chest.
chunks.en_new: paid it to the man and received the chest from him at once.

chunks.ar: شكر الرجل رئيس الشرطة، ووعده أن يذكر فضله،
chunks.en_old: The stranger thanked him
chunks.en_new: The man thanked the police chief and promised to remember his kindness,
chunks.note: omitted promise to remember his kindness

chunks.ar: ثم خرج مع خادمه في الليل.
chunks.en_old: and left with his servant under cover of night.
chunks.en_new: and left with his servant under cover of night.

chunks.ar: بقي الصندوق عند الرئيس، الذي لم يفحص ما فيه جيدًا،
chunks.en_old: The chief kept the chest without testing its contents
chunks.en_new: The chest stayed with the chief, who had not examined its contents closely,

chunks.ar: وفضل أن ينتظر الصباح لعرضه على أهل الخبرة.
chunks.en_old: and waited until morning for an expert.
chunks.en_new: preferring to wait until morning to show it to experts.

chunks.ar: في اليوم التالي استدعى أكبر الصاغة في المدينة، وطلب منه تقدير قيمة الجواهر.
chunks.en_old: The next day the chief summoned a master goldsmith.
chunks.en_new: The next day he summoned the city's leading goldsmith and asked him to value the jewels.
chunks.note: omitted request to value the jewels

chunks.ar: فحص الصائغ الأشياء واحدة واحدة،
chunks.en_old: After examining everything,
chunks.en_new: The goldsmith examined the items one by one,

chunks.ar: ثم أخبره أنها ليست ذهبًا ولا فضة،
chunks.en_old: the goldsmith declared the metal was brass and tin
chunks.en_new: then told him they were neither gold nor silver,
chunks.note: brass and tin belonged to next chunk

chunks.ar: بل نحاس وقصدير وأحجار من زجاج.
chunks.en_old: and the supposed gems were only glass.
chunks.en_new: but copper, tin and stones of glass.

chunks.ar: اشتد غضب رئيس الشرطة، وأرسل رجاله يبحثون عن الزائر،
chunks.en_old: Furious, the chief sent men after the stranger,
chunks.en_new: The police chief grew furious and sent his men to search for the visitor,

chunks.ar: فلم يجدوا له أثرًا.
chunks.en_old: but he had vanished.
chunks.en_new: but they found no trace of him.

chunks.ar: أدرك عندها أن المحتال لم يبع صندوق كنوز،
chunks.en_old: The supposed reformed robber
chunks.en_new: Then he realized the swindler had not sold a chest of treasure,

chunks.ar: بل اشترى بثمن رخيص ثقة رجل كان يظن نفسه خبيرًا باللصوص.
chunks.en_old: had fooled the very official charged with catching thieves.
chunks.en_new: but had cheaply bought the trust of a man who thought himself an expert on thieves.
